name: Chunk array
description: Splitting an array into fixed-size consecutive subarrays verified by unit test. Edge cases: short last chunk, empty input, size larger than length
prompt: Write solution.js in the sandbox. It must use CommonJS and export a function chunk(array, size) that splits array into consecutive subarrays of length size. The last subarray may be shorter if the array length is not a multiple of size. An empty array returns an empty array. The tests are in test_chunk.js; read them first. Use write_file. Then reply with the word done.
